1. (Currently amended) A modular humeral implant comprising a first humeral surface component removably attached to a second stem component, wherein said humeral surface component is adapted to articulate with a glenoid surface.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first humeral surface component is a humeral articulating surface and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral articulating surface has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, and wherein said humeral articulating surface is configured for minimally invasive implantation through a transhumeral portal.

4. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral articulating surface is spherically or elliptically shaped and configured for articulation with a glenoid component.

10. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral articulating surface is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials, and is configured to resist wear during articulation.

11. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface.

12. (Original) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral articulating surface has a smooth articulating surface configured for articulation with a glenoid component.

14. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Original) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Original) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Original) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a selectable length from a plurality of stem lengths, wherein said stem is adapted to extend from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral articulating surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral articulating surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw.

27. (Currently amended) A glenohumeral joint implant comprising an implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint to provide a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus.

28. (Currently amended) The glenohumeral joint implant of claim 27 wherein said implant is a modular humeral implant.

29. (Currently amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral articulating surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.

30. (Original) The humerus bone implant of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Original) The humerus bone implant of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
